analysis.action_line: VIX 19.97 Normal, S5FI 61.3% breadth, and Nikkei -4.15% global weakness imply focusing on RS leaders near support.
analysis.analysis_para1: Global markets are seeing significant downside pressure, with the Nikkei down 4.15%, DAX -1.31%, and FTSE -1.03%. This widespread overseas weakness does not yet translate into credit concerns, as 10Y yields are stable. Despite international declines, US market breadth remains healthy, evidenced by 61.3% of stocks above their 50-day moving average (S5FI) and 65.2% above their 200-day (MMTH). This divergence suggests US indices, particularly the Nasdaq, are showing strong resilience.
analysis.analysis_para2: The Nasdaq 100's strong pre-market performance (+0.75%) suggests continued tech leadership today. Watch for the S&P 500 (currently -0.01%) to hold the 7350 level as key support in the face of global selling. With VIX remaining normal at 19.97, the focus should remain on high relative strength thematic leaders, particularly in Hardware and Semiconductors. Entry should be sought on intraday pullbacks to short-term moving averages or established support, avoiding chasing extended moves. A decisive break below S&P 7300, especially accompanied by an uptick in VIX, would signal caution and necessitate re-evaluation.
analysis.technical_signal: No reversal pattern confirmed yet. US indices, particularly the Nasdaq, show resilience despite global weakness.
